createAccount.title: Creating Your Account
createAccount.step2: Enter your email address and create a password
createAccount.step3: Check your email for verification (auto-confirmed for faster access)
createAccount.step4: You're ready to link your Clash Royale account!

findTag.title: Finding Your Player Tag
findTag.intro: Your Player Tag is a unique identifier for your Clash Royale account. Here's how to find it:
findTag.step1: Open Clash Royale on your device
findTag.step2: Tap your profile picture in the top-left corner
findTag.step3: Your Player Tag is displayed below your name (starts with #)
findTag.step4: Copy the entire tag including the # symbol

multiAccount.title: Managing Multiple Accounts
multiAccount.intro: AI Royale supports up to 3 Clash Royale accounts per user:
multiAccount.point1: Add multiple accounts from the Player Selection screen
multiAccount.point2: Switch between accounts instantly without re-authenticating
multiAccount.point3: Each account has its own analytics, recommendations, and coaching history

overview.title: Dashboard Tabs
overview.intro: Your dashboard is organized into 9 main tabs, each offering specialized features:

navigation.title: Navigating the Dashboard
navigation.point1: Click any tab to switch views - your data is cached for fast loading
navigation.point2: On mobile, tabs are scrollable horizontally
navigation.point3: The AI Coach button (bottom-right) is accessible from any tab

sync.title: Data Sync & Refresh
sync.intro: Your data syncs automatically when you open the dashboard. You can manually refresh using the sync indicator in the header.
sync.note: Note: Clash Royale API has a 5-15 minute delay. Recent in-game changes may not appear immediately.

overview.title: Player Statistics
overview.intro: The Stats tab displays your key performance metrics:
overview.trophiesDesc: Your current trophy count and personal best
overview.arenaDesc: Your current arena based on trophy count
overview.clanDesc: Your clan name and badge (if member of a clan)

charts.title: Trophy Progress Chart
charts.intro: View your trophy progression over time with interactive charts showing gains and losses.

aiSummary.title: AI Coach Summary
aiSummary.intro: A personalized AI-generated summary of your recent performance, including strengths, areas for improvement, and strategic recommendations.

history.title: Battle History
history.intro: View your recent battles with detailed information:

detail.title: Match Detail View
detail.intro: Click any match to open detailed analysis:
detail.comparisonDesc: Side-by-side view of both decks with card levels
detail.analysisDesc: What happened in the match and recommendations
detail.momentsDesc: Pivotal card interactions at critical phases
detail.counterDesc: AI-suggested deck to beat your opponent

discuss.title: Discuss with AI Coach
discuss.intro: Click 'Discuss with AI Coach' to send match context to the AI for deeper strategic conversation and personalized advice.

current.title: Current Deck Display
current.intro: View your currently equipped deck with all 8 cards, their levels, and average elixir cost.

recommendations.title: Personalized Recommendations
recommendations.intro: AI Royale analyzes your profile to suggest decks that fit you:
recommendations.ownershipDesc: Only recommends decks where you own all 8 cards
recommendations.skillDesc: Matches deck difficulty to your trophy range
recommendations.adoptDesc: Click to track the recommendation and measure improvement

analysis.title: Deck Analysis Panel
analysis.intro: Get AI-powered analysis of your deck including synergies, weaknesses, and improvement suggestions.

create.title: Building a Deck
create.intro: Create custom decks with our visual deck builder:
create.step1: Click cards from the card pool to add them to your deck
create.step2: Click cards in your deck to remove them
create.step3: Watch the average elixir update in real-time
create.step4: Click 'AI Analysis' to get strategic insights
create.step5: Save your deck with a name and description

templates.title: Meta Templates Library
templates.intro: Browse pre-built competitive decks from the meta:
templates.point1: Filter by archetype (Beatdown, Cycle, Control, etc.)
templates.point2: Recommended decks (⭐) show decks you can build with your cards
templates.point3: Click any template to import it into the builder

compare.title: Deck Comparison
compare.point1: See elixir distribution and average cost differences
compare.point3: Run AI Matchup Prediction to see win probability and tips

deckStats.title: Deck Statistics Dashboard
deckStats.intro: Track your deck performance over time:
deckStats.point4: Most used cards across all your decks

mastery.title: Card Mastery System
mastery.intro: Track your proficiency with individual cards:
mastery.levelsDesc: Progress from Bronze to Master (10 tiers)
mastery.partnersDesc: Cards that work well with this card in your hands
mastery.matchupsDesc: Cards you struggle against when using this card
mastery.tipsDesc: Personalized advice for improving with this card

achievements.title: Achievements Dashboard
achievements.intro: Track your milestones and unlock achievement badges as you improve. Achievements are categorized by skill area and tier.

overview.title: Your Card Collection
overview.intro: View and manage all your Clash Royale cards:
overview.point1: Filter by rarity (Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary, Champion)
overview.point2: See current level and progress to next upgrade
overview.point3: Track total card count and upgrade requirements

levels.title: Understanding Card Levels
levels.intro: Card levels are displayed matching in-game levels. The range depends on rarity:

sync.title: Syncing Your Collection
sync.intro: Your collection syncs automatically with the Clash Royale API. If you notice missing cards, use the manual sync button.

yourRanking.title: Your Global Ranking
yourRanking.intro: See where your accounts rank globally. All your linked accounts are displayed with their current trophies and estimated global position.

global.title: Top 100 Global Players
global.intro: View the top 100 players worldwide. If your accounts appear in the top 100, they'll be highlighted.

clan.title: Clan Leaderboard
clan.intro: If you're in a clan, see how you rank among clan members and how your clan ranks globally.

browse.title: Browsing Tournaments
browse.registrationDesc: Sign up before the tournament starts

create.title: Creating a Tournament
create.step2: Set name, description, max participants, and start date
create.step3: Share with your clan or friends to join

search.title: Searching for Clans
search.point1: Search by clan name or clan tag
search.point2: View clan details including member count and trophy requirements
search.point3: Send join requests to Invite Only clans

overview.title: Using the AI Coach
overview.intro: Your personal Clash Royale strategy advisor:
overview.step1: Click the floating chat button in the bottom-right corner
overview.step2: Type your question or select a suggested topic
overview.step3: Receive personalized advice based on your actual game data

context.title: What the AI Knows
context.intro: The AI Coach has access to your complete profile:
context.point1: Your saved decks and their performance
context.point2: Your card mastery levels and win rates

proactive.title: Proactive Suggestions
proactive.intro: When your win rate drops below 55%, the AI Coach will proactively suggest deck changes. Look for the pulsing amber badge on the chat button.

quota.title: Daily AI Quota
quota.intro: AI coaching uses a daily quota system to ensure fair usage for all players.
quota.limit: Free limit: 10 AI requests per day. Quota resets at midnight UTC.

tips.title: Tips for Better Responses
tips.tip1: Be specific about what you want help with
tips.tip2: Mention the deck archetype you're asking about
tips.tip3: Reference specific matchups you're struggling with
tips.tip4: Use the 'Discuss' button from match details for context-aware coaching

language.title: Language Selection
language.intro: AI Royale supports 5 languages. Change your language using the selector in the navigation bar. All AI coaching responses will be generated in your selected language.

notifications.title: Notification Center
notifications.intro: View all past notifications including achievement unlocks, sync updates, and recommendations. Click the bell icon in the header to open the notification history.

progress.title: Global Progress Center
progress.intro: See all active background operations (syncing, calculations, analyses) in real-time. Click the activity indicator in the header to view detailed progress.

comparison.title: Account Comparison
comparison.intro: Compare stats across your linked accounts to see which is performing better and identify areas for improvement.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Why doesn't my latest deck show up?
faq.a1: The Clash Royale API has a 5-15 minute delay. Your recent in-game changes will appear after this delay. Try refreshing in a few minutes.
faq.q2: How is my win rate calculated?
faq.a2: Win rate is calculated from your last 25 battles available from the API. It only includes ladder and challenge battles, not friendly battles or 2v2.
faq.q3: Why are some features requiring login?
faq.a3: Features like saving decks, AI coaching, and personalized recommendations require an account to store your preferences and history.
faq.q4: Can I use AI Royale on mobile?
faq.a4: Yes! AI Royale is fully responsive and works on all devices. The interface adapts to your screen size.
faq.q5: How accurate are the AI matchup predictions?
faq.a5: Predictions are based on deck composition analysis and historical data. Actual results may vary based on skill level and card levels.
faq.q6: Why can't I add more than 3 accounts?
faq.a6: The 3-account limit ensures fair usage of our AI services and API resources for all users.
faq.q7: How do I change my email or password?
faq.a7: Account management features are available through the authentication system. Contact support if you need to change your email.
faq.a8: Yes! We use industry-standard encryption and never store your Clash Royale login credentials. We only access public data through your Player Tag.
